reviews.title: Just a terrible app honestly
reviews.text:
This app is a complete disaster. I’ve attempted to use it multiple times, and without fail, every single profile I create gets blocked for “impersonation” – an accusation that’s not only false, but entirely unjustified. I’ve followed every single step, completed every challenge, submitted every required photo, and still get banned for no legitimate reason.

What makes this worse is the apps customer support. Messages go unanswered for days, sometimes weeks – if they even respond at all. There’s zero accountability, zero transparency, and zero willingness to help users who are wrongly penalized.

At this point, I’ve gone through the process so many times, I could be a moderator – which is ironic, because the moderators currently in place seem completely unqualified for the job. Their inability to distinguish between genuine users and actual impersonators is laughable, if it weren’t so frustrating.

The system is broken, the support is nonexistent, and the moderation is an embarrassment. 

Save yourself the trouble honestly at this point

reviews.title: Suspended on my first day

My account was suspended on the first day of downloading the app for being suspect of impersonating someone else. But the problem is that I was never warned about it. I could tell there was something wrong with my profile but I only fount out when I reached out to Jack’d.

I understand that dating apps have to be watchful about profiles trying to impersonate people who they are not. However, I have provided the info they requested and proved to be who I am, but have still not received a response or gotten the suspension lifted.

Overall, not a pleasant experience at all.
